content.thinking: After 8 years the calculator shows about 68,853 ₪ left (48,000 ₪ invested, plus 9,581 ₪ from the tax refund and 11,272 ₪ in returns after fees), but for self-employed people it gives no figure at 4 years, only a note that withdrawals are taxed before 6 years. I'm fairly sure of the 8-year number, but I'm not sure the 4-year case has anything to show.

input.answer: After 8 years I'd have about 68,853 ₪ ("נשאר בידיים", at 500 ₪ a month, of which 48,000 ₪ is what I put in). For 4 years the calculator gives no number for self-employed people: it only says that before 6 years there's no calculation yet and you pay tax.

stuck.why: The big number 25,725 sits above an empty dashed box, so I first took it as my 4-year amount. Its label 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך' is only underneath, and I had to scroll to see it.
The fields rearranged and moved sideways; the return field ended up where the fee field had been.
